name: application-pack
title: Application review pack: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from applications order by code

sections.title: Application
sections.note: No statutory approval is conferred by this document.

sections.title: Evidence checklist
sections.sql: select requirement,finding from evidence_gaps where application_id=$1 order by requirement

sections.title: Inspection record
sections.sql: select code,name,inspector,due_on,outcome,report_ref from inspections where application_id=$1 order by code

name: evidence-request
title: Evidence request: draft for officer review
for_each: select id,code from applications where status='open' order by code

sections.title: Application and applicant
sections.sql: select code,name,applicant,owner from application_readiness where id=$1

sections.title: Please review these outstanding items
sections.sql: select requirement,finding from evidence_gaps where application_id=$1 and finding<>'Complete' order by requirement
sections.note: Confirm the request wording and applicable authority before sending. This draft has not been sent.

name: renewal-review
title: Licence renewal review: internal draft
for_each: select id,code from licences where expires_on<=CURRENT_DATE+60 order by code

sections.title: Conditions
sections.sql: select code,name,owner,review_on,status,evidence_ref from conditions where licence_id=$1 order by code
sections.note: A renewal requires a new application and an officer decision. This paper neither renews a licence nor records payment.
